title: A-16: matrix distribution claims must match the canonical matrix, not a curated phrasing list
businessRules: A-16 is canonical in config/product-completeness.json postAuditFindings; closure requires the phase exit criteria and a derived control, not marker presence. The finding says the A-14 guard enforces a curated phrasing list, and a curated list fails on the first phrasing nobody thought of.

Measured 2026-10-15: four governance documents (docs/PROJECT-STATE.md twice, handoff/CURRENT-WORK.md three times) asserted '16 IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_PENDING, 2 RUNTIME_VERIFIED' while config/product-completeness.json held 17 and 1. The defect was introduced in the A-13/A-15 session and survived every local and CI gate because status-doc-currency.test.mjs only matches LIVE_CLAIM phrasings such as 'currently holds' and 'current count is', and that prose never used one. A-14's own closing notes recorded the limitation ('a new undated claim written in words outside the list would not trip the guard'); this is that limitation materialising.

The fix is a derived rule, not a longer list. A distribution claim is any sentence that names two or more of the canonical status tokens; inside it, every 'N STATUS' must equal the count in config/product-completeness.json (features or postAuditFindings). The tokens and counts come from the matrix itself, so there is no phrasing to curate and no name to forget.

A bare 'N STATUS' is deliberately not checked: '27 FOUNDATION, 3 PARTIAL' would otherwise read 3 as FOUNDATION's count, and phase designators such as 'P2 RUNTIME_VERIFIED' or 'P5 IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_PENDING' carry no count at all. The two-or-more-tokens-per-sentence requirement is what separates a distribution claim from a phase label, and it was measured: the naive form produced 12 hits with 2 false positives; this form produced 9 with none.
handoff/generated/ is excluded from the scan because it is derived from the same source each run and cannot drift on its own; counting it would report one defect under two filenames.

No business logic, API contract, permission, tenant or branch authority, schema, runtime path or gate predicate may be weakened to make this pass. productReady, currentPhase and humanStage20 stay untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/status-doc-currency.test.mjs fails when a governance document asserts a status distribution that disagrees with config/product-completeness.json, regardless of the wording used.
A control proves the negative case on the exact phrasing that shipped wrong ('16 IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_PENDING, 2 RUNTIME_VERIFIED') and the positive case on the corrected counts.
Phase designators ('P2 RUNTIME_VERIFIED', 'P5 IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_PENDING') and single-token mentions are not flagged, so the rule does not demand an escape hatch.
The 9 real defects are corrected in docs/PROJECT-STATE.md and handoff/CURRENT-WORK.md, and no residual wrong count remains outside handoff/generated/.
productReady, currentPhase and humanStage20 stay untouched.
Both GitHub heavy workflows and Workflow Governance stay green on the exact commit.
testPlan: GitHub exact-source Full Automated UAT and Full System Simulation
migrationPlan: No schema migration. Only the currency test and the governance prose change; no database object is added, altered or dropped.
rollbackPlan: Revert the commit. The distribution rule and its controls disappear, the curated LIVE_CLAIM list remains, and the four prose locations return to the wrong counts. Nothing else changes and no data is written.
monitoringPlan: The distribution control runs inside the dependency-free suite on every local run and on both heavy workflows, so a status distribution that disagrees with the matrix fails the build rather than propagating into handoff and project state.
securityNotes: No secret, token, credential or personal data appears in any file this work item edits, and none may be introduced. This is a governance-strength change only.
